title: K-flat module-complex model for a quasi-coherent affine derived object
statement: For a commutative ring R, every Q in D_QCoh(Spec R) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme] is isomorphic in the sheaf derived category to Q(tilde M) for a K-flat cochain complex M of R-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. The tilde functor is applied termwise. There is no boundedness or flatness assumption on Q.

source.place: Tag 06Z0 (lemma-affine-compare-bounded), with K-flat module resolutions, Tag 08DV

proof.text: Apply the core affine derived equivalence to the full-subcategory object (Q,hQ). Choose a complex representing its inverse image under the essentially surjective derived localization. Apply the equivalence functor, its counit, the fully faithful inclusion, and the termwise tilde comparison to get Q isomorphic to Q(tilde M).

Resolve M by a K-flat module complex P with quasi-isomorphism pi. Localization inverts pi. The equivalence and inclusion preserve that isomorphism. The natural tilde comparison transports invertibility to Q(tilde pi). Compose the model isomorphism with its inverse to obtain Q isomorphic to Q(tilde P).

theorem exists_affineQCohComplexModel
    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (Q : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec R))
    (hQ : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec R) Q) :
    ∃ M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M ∧
      Nonempty (Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
            (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
              SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
              (tilde.functor R)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M))
